messages:
Noah Li: Heads-up: launching a small preview of the Hardened VPC Networking Stack for Private deployments next week. Compliance-first defaults + opt-in migration.

Marta Silva: Good. Where's the concise runbook?

Noah Li: https://internal.redwood/hvns-preview (internal). Highlights: default-deny network policy, egress allowlist shim, immutable audit snapshots to customer KMS storage, telemetry minimization toggle.

Ravi Patel (Security): This maps to SOC2/HIPAA pilot asks. Added an attestations endpoint and short/long retention options (30/90/365). Will post the API spec.

Priya Kapoor (Legal): For customer-facing copy avoid absolutes like "we delete". Use "minimize telemetry and provide opt-in export/erase". Need final dataflow diagrams before external comms.

Ethan Brooks: Migration notes? Agent restarts? rollback?

Noah Li: Migration is online with a 72-hour validation window. No agent restart for the shim; KMS-backed snapshots require a brief handshake on first run. Rollback = Console toggle + auto-revert on failed health checks.

Marta Silva: Ops checklist snippet:
```
network:
  defaultDeny: true
  egress:
    allowedCIDRs: ["10.0.0.0/8"]
audit:
  immutableSnapshots: true
  snapshotRetentionDays: 90
telemetry:
  minimization: true
```

Ravi Patel (Security): We'll emit a signed compliance assertion per snapshot. Eng infra please validate in staging.

Noah Li: Action items: eng infra validate probe (Marta), security finalize attest API (Ravi), legal finalize wording (Priya), ops finalize rollback runbook (Ethan).

Infra Bot: deploybot: hvns-preview v0.9 -> staging succeeded :white_check_mark:

Ethan Brooks: I'll open a 2-hour support slot on GA+1.

Noah Li: Thanks. Add blockers to the runbook and DM me for escalations. Will publish KB + FAQ after legal sign-off.
